overall_summary: Analysis of 47 unique videos shows clear audience segmentation: immersive 'What If You Fell Into...' experiential space scenarios and extreme exoplanetary phenomenon drive the highest reach (700-1,050+ views, up to 3.7% like rate), whereas abstract psychology, generic brain trivia, and identical reposts consistently stall under 100 views. Videos between 19 and 21 seconds outperform shorter sub-16s clips in both engagement and view velocity.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-person extreme cosmic 'What If You Fell Into...' scenarios
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes, 2 comments) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) significantly outperform standard factual space statements.
winning_patterns.action: Use visceral second-person survival framing ('What happens when you drop into...') applied to terrifying cosmic and planetary environments.

winning_patterns.pattern: High-contrast paradoxes and extreme physical extremes in exoplanets
winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet of Burning Ice' (1,055 views), 'TrES-2b Darker Than Coal' (1,029 views), and 'Supersonic Rubies' (723 views) consistently crack top-tier viewership on the channel.
winning_patterns.action: Center hooks around sensory impossibilities (burning ice, diamond rain, supersonic gemstones) with vivid visual cues.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic psychology and repetitive memory trivia
weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' flopped repeatedly across three uploads (5, 10, and 53 views); 'Songs Stuck in Your Head' averaged under 50 views.
weak_patterns.action: Retire generic brain/psychology facts unless framed as a high-stakes psychological mystery or biological anomaly.

weak_patterns.pattern: Direct content reposting with identical scripts/titles
weak_patterns.evidence: Duplicate uploads of 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' and 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' saw sharp diminishing returns (dropping down to 34 views).
weak_patterns.action: Stop republishing identical assets; explore distinct entities within winning niches instead.
